body:
([Recording](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=hYcehreE8Nk))

1.  Topics

    1.  Highlight on rest spec changes

        1.  Adds EnableRowLineage Metadata Update (Thanks Russell!)
        2.  Add initial/write defaults to schema (Thanks Dan!)
        3.  Deprecate snapshot-id of SetStatisticsUpdate (Thanks Christian!)
        4.  Added ETag and If-None-Match headers and 304 response for table loading. (Thanks Gabor!)
    2.  On-going spec changes

        1.  Add RemoveSchemas REST update type

            1.  VOTE: <https://lists.apache.org/thread/n97qo5nb09ggz5591g7cp99767fv5cf7>
            2.  PR: <https://github.com/apache/iceberg/pull/12022>
            3.  Note: Old catalog service that not support new updates will fail
    3.  PR review: Auth manager PRs:

        1.  <https://github.com/apache/iceberg/pull/12197>
        2.  Wait for 1.8.0 release
        3.  Need to port to rust, python, go
    4.  RegisterTable/Notification

        1.  Discussion: <https://lists.apache.org/thread/kkj1f98v035p2k25jpcb5mboc9bpsk58>
        2.  For catalog sync: Initial agreement that pull-based is needed for correctness, and the “YOLO” approach can be used to help avoid polling a pull-based endpoint

            1.  Pull based avoids the need to allow push
            2.  Usability (push requires config on both sides)
            3.  Other uses for events (driving table maintenance)
        3.  For the thread above, register table force would solve the issue
    5.  SQL UDF:

        1.  Use-case example: access control
        2.  Idea: similar to views: multi SQL dialect support
        3.  Existing proposal: <https://github.com/apache/iceberg/issues/10432>
